name: Simian Spirit Guide
oracle_text: Exile this card from your hand: Add {R}.
blocked_sentences: Exile this card from your hand: Add {R}.

needs.what: an activated ability, activatable from hand, whose cost exiles the source card out of the hand -- the exile twin of cycling's discard_self. Concretely: let Cost.exile_self be payable from a non-battlefield zone (costs.can_pay currently hard-requires obj.on_battlefield at costs.py:688-694, while costs.pay at costs.py:1005 already calls exile_object(source_oid) which works from any zone), or add a sibling exile_self_from_hand flag so 'exile this artifact' on the battlefield keeps its stricter check. The loader already accepts the shape -- loader.py:2098 counts exile_self as a cost that removes the source, so an ability with active_zones: ['hand'] passes the outside-the-battlefield guard -- and the ability itself is an ordinary mana ability holding only add_mana {R}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_keys has exile_self, but it is documented and implemented as 'Exile this artifact' -- Phoenix Down -- and costs.can_pay returns False unless the source is on the battlefield, so an active_zones: ['hand'] ability written with it loads cleanly and can never be activated: a silently inert card, which is worse than none. discard_self is the only cost that is legal from hand, and it is the wrong zone -- Simian Spirit Guide must end in exile, not the graveyard, which is the entire difference between it and a card that could be dredged or reanimated back. The exile op is not an alternative either: an op runs at resolution, so 601.2h would be violated and, worse, a mana ability may contain only add_mana, so no op other than add_mana can appear here at all. Separately, costs.mana_sources walks only state.battlefield and only tap-only abilities, so even once the cost is payable the payment solver will not find this ability -- it is reachable only through the explicit activation path in legality._activate_zones, which does already walk the player's own hand.
